### Summary

Some collections, such as ansible.utils, have an entity called sub_plugins that include DOCUMENTATION blocks that are not visible in docs.ansible.com or probably not in `ansible-doc`.  These sub_plugins are important to end users and their information should be displayed.

Examples of sub_plugins:

https://github.com/ansible-collections/ansible.utils/tree/main/plugins/sub_plugins

### Issue Type

Documentation Report

### Component Name

docs/docsite/rst/

### Ansible Version

```console
2.9, 2.11
```


### Configuration

```console
$ ansible-config dump --only-changed
```


### OS / Environment

Fedora 33

### Additional Information

This added information will improve the user experience.

### Code of Conduct

- [X] I agree to follow the Ansible Code of Conduct
